==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Veliaf Hurtz]] outside the church in [[Slepe]].
|startmap = 3729,3319
|difficulty = Master
|description = A darkness has fallen over Morytania. The Myreque freedom fighters have achieved their first major victory over the vampyres with the death of [[Ranis Drakan]]. However, their newly found hope is unlikely to last. After many years of absence, [[Lord Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan|Lord Lowerniel Drakan]], the vampyre overlord of Morytania, has finally emerged from his castle. He has but one goal. To avenge his brother and eradicate the Myreque once and for all.
